intro: Good evening, gentlemen. Gameweek 9 is done. Results included Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd, Bournemouth 2-0 Leeds and Brentford 2-0 Nott'm Forest. Jamie top-scored with 51; Louie managed 30. Ben leads on 460, 38 clear of Asher. Brahmes climbs 2 to 4th. As you were.
motw: Jamie scored 51, the best of the week. Van Hecke (15), Kelleher (7) and Manzambi (7) did the heavy lifting. Now 8th on 336.
stinker: 30 points. That's the lot. Van de Ven top-scored with 6, which tells you how the rest went. Down 1 to 6th.
bench: 20 points left on the bench. Verbruggen (11), Ødegaard (3) and Boscagli (6) watched from the side. Team selection remains an art, not a science.
bench_jam: Guéhi didn't play, so Tzolis came off Louie's bench and scored 3. Luck is a skill if you say it confidently.
red_card: Mateta (Crystal Palace) returned -2 for Jack. Featuring a red card.
gloves: Tzolakis (Hull City) scored 1 for Louie. Conceded 2. Made 1 saves, for what it's worth.
